verdict.rationale: WorkOS docs say its MCP server lets an agent "read and change the same dashboard data you can (managing organizations, connections, users, branding, and more) by calling the WorkOS API on your behalf." That is an explicit first-party claim of dashboard-to-API parity. It is backed by RBAC being configurable "in the WorkOS Dashboard or using the API," a published OpenAPI spec, and official SDKs. missing for 10: an exhaustive parity matrix or independent hands-on corroboration; some settings, such as MFA enablement, are documented only via the dashboard Authentication page.
